historySource.indexText: Despite a decisive tactical victory over a larger Union force on June 10, 1864, Major General N. B. Forrest’s Confederates ultimately failed to disrupt Union supply lines critical to Brigadier General W.T. Sherman’s Atlanta campaign. United States Colored Troops (USCT) played a crucial role in the Federals’ retreat. Established Feb. 21, 1929; transferred from War Dept. Aug. 10, 1933.
